events.description: Multiple individuals, including shirtless men and others, engage in mutual physical combat near a doorway; police officers intervene with batons and a dog, escalating into a chaotic group scuffle involving pushing, striking, and grappling.

A violent group clash erupts as multiple civilians and police officers converge in a confined street space, with objects being thrown or wielded (e.g., long stick), people running, falling, and engaging in coordinated aggressive actions—indicating collective violent unrest beyond isolated fighting.
Multiple uniformed officers and civilians engage in physical combat on a street; one officer swings a baton-like object while others grapple and strike.
An officer appears to strike a person who is on or near the ground during the melee, suggesting targeted violence against a vulnerable individual.
A chaotic street scene with multiple individuals (including uniformed personnel) running, chasing, and engaging in violent group confrontations, consistent with collective violent unrest.

Multiple uniformed officers are seen restraining and subduing a person on the ground near a storefront; the individual appears helpless and is being held down by at least three officers, consistent with physical abuse of a restrained person.
A dog is seen lunging or attacking a person who is crouching or falling near pillars on a sidewalk; the interaction involves active physical engagement between the animal and human.
A man lies on the ground while multiple uniformed officers surround and physically assault him, including striking him with batons and dragging him; he appears helpless and does not resist.
A civilian in dark clothing engages in physical struggle with officers near the prone man; there is mutual grappling and resistance observed in frames f3–f6.

A police officer in a white shirt and dark cap is seen bending over and appearing to strike or forcefully push a person who is on the ground or in a low position, while another officer stands nearby. The action is aggressive and directed at a non-resisting individual.

Two officers are seen placing a person into the rear of a blue 'CITY POLICE' van; one officer appears to be using force to push the individual inside, with visible arm motion suggesting coercion rather than voluntary entry.

Officers are actively forcing an individual into a yellow 'DOG UNIT' vehicle with barred compartments; multiple frames show officers grabbing, pushing, and shoving the person into the confined space, indicating coercive handling of a restrained or helpless individual.

Multiple uniformed officers are seen physically restraining and subduing a person on the ground in a narrow street; the individual appears unable to resist, indicating abuse of power against a helpless victim.

A group of uniformed officers surrounds and aggressively confronts a seated individual wearing camouflage and a yellow cap, who appears restrained or incapacitated; officers raise batons and firearms in threatening postures while the individual remains on the ground or low to the ground throughout the sequence.

At the beginning of the sequence, an officer in the center (visible in f0–f2) appears to strike or push a civilian in a white shirt with his arm/shoulder, while other officers advance; this initial physical contact constitutes mutual or one-sided combat before the scene stabilizes into a standoff.

A group of uniformed officers surrounds and confronts two unarmed civilians, one kneeling and one standing with hands raised or behind back; officers point rifles directly at them in a threatening manner, consistent with coercive abuse of power.

Multiple individuals in the crowd engage in mutual physical combat with police officers and among themselves, including pushing, grabbing, and striking motions; the confrontation escalates over time with increasing numbers involved.
A large, agitated crowd confronts a line of uniformed officers in a sustained, chaotic clash involving multiple participants, indicative of collective violent unrest rather than isolated incidents.

A man in a light-colored shirt and dark pants is seen raising both arms and striking or grappling with another individual in the center of the crowd; multiple surrounding individuals appear to be involved in physical contact, including pushing and shoving.

Sustained collective unrest: dense crowd actively confronting uniformed officers, with repeated pushing, gesturing, and physical engagement; some individuals raise sticks or objects, and the overall scene shows loss of order and coordinated agitation against authority.
